SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

S. 1, Special Branch Station. File No. .................... Date June 11, 1941.

SUBJECT: Public Works Department - strike of
coolies in Yenping Road Depot settled

The strike declared on June 6 by the 1,100
coolies attached to the Yenping Road Depot of the
Public Works Department, S.M.C. came to an end
during the afternoon of June 10. The majority
resumed work at 1.15 p.m. and the situation in
this depot is now normal.

Subsequent to the strike, negotiations
were held between the coolies' representatives and
the P.W.D. Authorities. During the afternoon of
June 9, Mr. Barker, Engineer of the P.W.D.,
interviewed TSAI HWA LEE ( 蔡華記 ) and TSANG
CHOK SUNG ( 張菊生 ), Foremen No.197 and 39
respectively of Yenping Road Depot. These two foremen
acted in the capacity of labour delegates and
conveyed the coolies' request for the (1) transfer
of Mr. PHROZ, Supervisor of the Yenping Road Depot,
and (2) reinstatement of the dismissed foreman
No.56 or the issue of a gratuity.

In reply, Mr. Barker pointed out that the
coolies were not in a position to demand the transfer
of the supervisor of the depot, and therefore the
request could not be considered. With regard to
the second demand, he informed the coolie representa-
tives that according to the decision of the P.W.D.
Authorities, the dismissed foreman could not be
reinstated but Mr. Barker agreed to consult the
authorities regarding the issue of a gratuity. No
compromise was reached during that afternoon and the

主题：工务局——延平路堆栈苦力罢工已解决

由上海公共租界工部局延平路堆栈所属的1,100名苦力于6月6日宣布的罢工，于6月10日下午结束。大多数人于下午1时15分复工，该堆栈的局势现已恢复正常。

罢工发生后，苦力代表与工务局当局进行了谈判。6月9日下午，工务局工程师巴克先生（Mr. Barker）接见了延平路堆栈的第197号和第39号工头蔡华记（TSAI HWA LEE）和张菊生（TSANG CHOK SUNG）。这两名工头以劳工代表的身份行事，转达了苦力的要求：(1) 调离延平路堆栈主管普罗兹先生（Mr. PHROZ）；(2) 复职被解雇的第56号工头，或发放一笔酬金。

S.1 Special Branch,
June 6, 1941.

Public Works Department - Unrest among
coolies in Yenping Road Depot
------------------------------------

At 6.45 a.m. June 6, some 1,100 coolies attached
to the Yenping Road Depot of the Public Works Department,
S.M.C. declared a strike in support of a foreman named
KAU PAUNG LING ( 高 邦 成 ) (Badge No.56), who was
dismissed on the previous day for insubordination.

According to the foreman, he was instructed to
supervise road construction work with ten coolies at
Yenping Road near Connaught Road, and was told to
complete the same during the afternoon of June 5. The
foreman was of the opinion that the particular work
required the services of fifteen coolies for two days
and therefore he was unable to complete the work in
half a day. He claimed that due to misunderstanding,
he was dismissed by Mr. Phorz, in charge of the Yenping
Road Depot. As a protest against his dismissal, the
coolies resorted to a strike this morning.

Police from Gordon Road Station and members
of Special Branch attended and found the majority of
coolies gathered in the depot and on Yenping Road
until about 10.30 a.m. when they dispersed.

Mr. Barker, Engineer of the P.W.D., also
attended Yenping Road Depot at 10 a.m. It was arranged
that two coolie representatives be appointed to discuss
a settlement of the dispute.

Two coolies named Ting Siao Hung ( 丁 小 红 )
(No.246) and LOO AN YU ( 羅 阿 玉 ) (No.399),
representing their colleagues were brought to the
P.W.D. Head Office and interviewed by Mr. Schoenhauer

1941年6月6日。

工务局——延平路堆栈苦力骚动
---

1941年6月6日上午6时45分，上海公共租界工部局工务局延平路堆栈所属约1,100名苦力宣布罢工，以支持名为高邦成（KAU PAUNG LING）（警号56）的工头，该工头前一日因不服从命令而被解雇。

据该工头称，他奉命在康纳路附近的延平路段，带领十名苦力监督道路施工，并被告知要在6月5日下午完成该项工作。该工头认为，该项特定工作需要十五名苦力工作两天，因此他无法在半天内完成工作。他声称，由于误会，他被负责延平路堆栈的福尔兹先生（Mr. Phorz）解雇。为抗议其被解雇，苦力于今晨采取罢工行动。

戈登路捕房的警察和特别分部成员到场，发现大多数苦力聚集在堆栈内和延平路上，直到上午10时30分左右散去。

工务局工程师巴克先生也于上午10时到达延平路堆栈。经安排，指定两名苦力代表讨论解决纠纷事宜。

两名名为丁小红（Ting Siao Hung）（第246号）和罗阿玉（LOO AN YU）（第399号）的苦力代表其同事被带到工务局总部，并接受舍恩豪尔先生（Mr. Schoenhauer）的问话

page_data.en:
(2)

They were advised to resume work at 1 p.m. June 6,
but no result was reached. The coolie representatives
departed at 12.30 p.m.

While no written demands have yet been submitted,
it is learned that the coolies are:
(1) Demanding the reinstatement of the dismissed foreman;
(2) Dissatisfied with the alleged mal-treatment of
coolies by Mr. Thorz, supervisor of Yenping Road
Depot.
(3) Opposing a reduction in their rice allowance.

It appears that general unrest exists among the
coolies against the foreign supervisor of the depot. He
is accused of being responsible for alleged ill-treatment
of coolies. They are of the opinion that since the
appointment of the foreign supervisor to take charge of
Yenping Road Depot, the distribution of work has not
been carried out in a satisfactory manner, and the
coolies have suffered to a considerable extent.

Information to hand reveals that the coolies may
extend the strike if no satisfaction is obtained in
connection with the existing dispute, and that they may
resort to acts of intimidation in order to reach their
ends on June 7.

Certified true copy
O. L. Bha
------------------
SNC.
page_data.zh:
(2)

他们被劝告于6月6日下午1时复工，但未取得结果。苦力代表于中午12时30分离去。

虽然尚未提交书面要求，但据悉苦力的诉求如下：
(1) 要求复职被解雇的工头；
(2) 对延平路堆栈主管索尔兹先生（Mr. Thorz）涉嫌虐待苦力表示不满。
(3) 反对减少他们的米贴。

看来苦力中对堆栈的外籍主管存在普遍的不满情绪。他被指控应对涉嫌虐待苦力一事负责。他们认为，自从任命该外籍主管负责延平路堆栈以来，工作分配未能以令人满意的方式进行，苦力遭受了相当大的损失。

现有情报显示，如果现有的纠纷得不到满意解决，苦力可能会延长罢工，并且他们可能会在6月7日采取恐吓手段以达到目的。

核证无误副本
O. L. Bha
---

S. 1, Special Branch S'dtion/ File No. ________________ Date June 7, 1941.

SUBJECT: Public Works Department - unrest among
coolies in Yenping Road Depot

The unrest existing amongst 1,100 coolies
attached to the Yenping Road Depot of the Public
Works Department, S.M.C. continues this morning,
June 7.

Some 1,000 coolies turned up at Yenping
Road Depot at 5.30 a.m. but refused to start work.
They subsequently left the depot on the advice of
their chief foreman and foreign staff. The majority
dispersed leaving some 100 coolies on Yenping Road
in the vicinity of the depot.

Following the strike, several cases of
intimidation have been reported. At about 5 p.m.,
June 6, one motor truck of the P.W.D. was damaged
by strikers near Markham Road Bridge.

At about 6 a.m. June 7, some 80 strikers
assembled in the vicinity of House No. 1 Penang
Road and attempted to induce the scavengers to
join the strike. As a result, a number of scavengers
were unable to start work. One garbage cart was
also damaged on Gordon Road. At 9 a.m., a light
truck of the P.W.D. (licence No. 19250) was attacked
with stones by strikers on Yenping Road near Changping
Road with the result that the car was damaged and
the chauffeur was injured.

主题：工务局——延平路堆栈苦力骚动

上海公共租界工部局工务局延平路堆栈所属1,100名苦力中存在的骚动，在今晨（6月7日）仍在继续。

约1,000名苦力于上午5时30分出现在延平路堆栈，但拒绝开始工作。随后，在他们的首席工头和外籍职员的建议下离开了堆栈。大多数人散去，在堆栈附近的延平路上留下了约100名苦力。

罢工发生后，据报道发生了几起恐吓事件。6月6日下午5时许，工务局的一辆卡车在马克姆路桥附近被罢工者损坏。

6月7日上午6时许，约80名罢工者在槟榔路1号附近集结，试图诱使清道夫加入罢工。结果，一些清道夫无法开始工作。戈登路上还有一辆垃圾车受损。上午9时，工务局的一辆轻型卡车（牌照号19250）在延平路靠近昌平路处遭到罢工者石块袭击，导致车辆受损，司机受伤。

REPORT

S.1. Special Branch. Station File No. ____ Date May 22, 1941.

SUBJECT: Public Works Department - anonymous letters

With reference to the attached letters received by Mr. G.E. Barker, Engineer of the Public Works Department, S.M.C., discreet enquiries have so far proved unsuccessful in obtaining any clue to the identity of the writers.

It is learned that there are 373 coolies attached to the Shunteh Road Materials Depot, 103 of whom were formerly issued enamelled badges from No. 1 to No. 103, whilst the remainder were given paper badges from No. 104 to No. 373. Only those coolies with enamelled badges were reported to have been previously entitled to work on Sundays and holidays when extra work was available. This system was eventually discontinued in consequence of a decision of Mr. Barker, and all the coolies were then issued uniform enamelled badges. As a result, all the coolies were entitled to equal treatment in respect to the distribution of extra work on Sundays and Holidays. This action is believed to have incurred the dissatisfaction of a few coolies who had hitherto been in possession of enamelled badges.

（批：Copy To Mr Barker）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE MAY 23 1941 ASSIST COMMISSIONER SPECIAL BRANCH）
（批：Sent 23/5）

主题：工务局 - 匿名信

关于工部局工务局工程师 G.E. Barker 先生收到的附函，经秘密查访，迄今未能获得任何关于写信人身份的线索。

据悉，顺德路材料堆栈雇有苦力373名，其中103名此前获发编号为1至103的搪瓷徽章，其余人员则获发编号为104至373的纸质徽章。只有持有搪瓷徽章的苦力才被报告有权在周日及节假日有额外工作时上岗。由于 Barker 先生的决定，该制度最终被废止，所有苦力随后均获发统一的搪瓷徽章。因此，所有苦力在周日及节假日额外工作的分配方面均享有同等待遇。据信，此举引起了少数此前持有搪瓷徽章的苦力的不满。

（批：抄送 Barker 先生）
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1941年5月23日 助理总监 特别科）
（批：5月23日发出）

关于信中针对领班 MEI LIANG NGOH（梅良鶴）的指控，经查未能证实他曾向苦力索取50.00美元以将其纸质徽章更换为搪瓷徽章。有理由相信这些指控或多或少有所夸大，因为所提及的金额似乎超出了苦力的支付能力。

目前，顺德路材料堆栈的苦力中尚未出现普遍骚乱的迹象。

助理总监（特别科）

REPORT

S.I, Special Branch. Station / File No. ____ Date April 2, 1941.

SUBJECT: Public Works Department - anonymous letter
received by Chinese supervisor

On March 25, an anonymous letter was received
by TSZE ZUNG SAN (朱永山), Chinese supervisor attached
to the Yenping Road Depot of the Highway Division of the
Public Works Department, S.M.C. It states that MO WOO
TSZE (麻五子) and MO SAN HONG (麻三红), two foremen
of the Public Works Department would make an attempt on
the life of the supervisor within one week.

In this connection, TSZE ZUNG SAN was inter-
viewed at Headquarters on April 1 when he stated that
one week has already elapsed since he received the letter
and nothing has yet happened. He suspects that the
letter originated from coolies of the highway division
although he could supply no definite information as to
the name of the writer or writers. He appears to pay
little attention to the matter as, according to his own
statement, he has received similar anonymous letters on
several previous occasions.

When questioned, TSZE ZUNG SAN could give no
reason as to why MO WOO TSZE and MO SAN HONG, whose names
are mentioned in the anonymous letter, should wish to
make an attempt on his life, but he is believed to have
incurred their displeasure on account of his attitude
towards the P.W.D. Coolies' Union, 59 Jukong Road, Chapei.
Both MO WOO TSZE and MO SAN HONG are said to be active
in the organization of the Union.

According to the supervisor, the letter has
been handed over to the P.W.D. authorities for information.

A.C. (Special Branch). DATE 2/4/41

主题：工务局 - 华籍监工收到的匿名信

3月25日，工部局工务局公路股延平路堆栈的华籍监工 TSZE ZUNG SAN（朱永山）收到一封匿名信。信中指出，工务局的两名领班 MO WOO TSZE（麻五子）和 MO SAN HONG（麻三红）将在一周内企图谋杀该监工。

就此事宜，TSZE ZUNG SAN 于4月1日在总部接受问询，他表示自收到信件以来一周已过，尚未发生任何事件。他怀疑信件出自公路股的苦力之手，尽管他无法提供关于写信人姓名的确切信息。他似乎对此事不太在意，因为据他自己陈述，他此前曾多次收到类似的匿名信。

当被问及为何匿名信中提到的 MO WOO TSZE 和 MO SAN HONG 会企图谋杀他时，TSZE ZUNG SAN 无法给出理由，但据信他因对位于闸北菊康路59号的工务局苦力工会的态度而招致二人的不满。据说 MO WOO TSZE 和 MO SAN HONG 均积极参与该工会的组织工作。

据该监工称，该信件已移交工务局当局知悉。

With reference to the attached newspaper
translation dated March 14, 1941, appearing in

accusation made by Hsu Hsiang Yue (許長友)
and Shao Tsco Ih (邵叔一), respectively coolies
Nos. 266 and 270 of the P.W.D., which resulted
in the arrest of Nyien Kwang Hai (嚴廣海),
a member of Executive Committee of the P.W.D. Road
Construction Coolies' Mutual Aid Society, enquiries
made revealed that Nyien Kwang Hai, aged 28, native
of Kompo, was formerly a scavenger coolie of the
P.W.D., S.M.C. He is at present unemployed. Nyien,
it is reported, used to call at the Shunteh Road
Depot of the P.W.D. and collect membership fees
from the coolies at the depot. The coolies were
asked to pay a monthly membership fee of $1.00 each.
If they refused, Nyien would intimidate them. This
illegal collection of membership fees on the part
of Nyien was later brought to the notice of Mr. Holt,
Chief Inspector of the P.W.D. Highways Department
by Hsu Hsiang Yue and Shao Tsco Ih. Mr. Holt, in
company with Hsu and Shao, reported the matter to
the Sinza Police Station.

Acting upon ~~receiving~~ this information,
detectives effected the arrest of Nyien Kwang Hai
at 4.30 p.m. on March 6, 1941, in the act of

Commr. of Police.

COMMISSIONER

March 14, 1941    Morning Translation.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE * 14 MAR. 1941）

Chinese-American Daily News, Cheng Yien Pao, National Herald,
Sin Wan Pao and Shan Pao :-

THE RICE SITUATION

Despite the arrival of large quantities of
rice, the price of rice in private transactions at the rice
mart yesterday registered a sudden increase of $6 to $7 per
zar, breaking all records of daily increases in Shanghai.
Through the activities of the rice worms, the question of
the food supplies of the people has reached a most serious
stage and unless immediate measures are adopted by the
authorities of the two Foreign Settlements, peace and order
in the Settlements will be seriously endangered.
In private transactions yesterday, an
additional sum of $3,400 was demanded with the purchase of
every 100 bags of Siao Chiao rice, $3,200 for every 100 bags
of Saigon rice, both first and second grade qualities, and
$3,000 for Siamese rice. The price of broken rice has
already reached as high as $90 per zar. In short, an increase
of $20 per zar has been registered during the past two weeks.
The following are the principal causes for
this heavy rise in the price of rice:-
(1) Utter disregard by speculators of the
measures to be adopted against them by the authorities.
(2) Lack of sufficient energy and power on
the part of the rice trading guilds to adjust the affairs
of the rice mart.
(3) Manipulation of present stocks by
hoarders.
(4) Purchases made at the rice mart by
unscrupulous elements under the protection of special
influence.
Consequently, in order to stabilize the
price of rice, the following measures should be adopted as
soon as possible:-
(1) That plain-clothes men be immediately
detailed to make enquiries and to arrest all persons suspected
of hoarding or manipulation.
(2) That hoarders be forced to dispose of
their stocks to rice shops to be sold by retail.
(3) That the organization of rice trading
bodies be strengthened so that they can quickly adjust the
affairs of the rice mart.
(4) That outsiders be strictly prohibited
from making purchases at the rice mart through unscrupulous
elements.
(5) That, with the funds already raised from
various trades, orders be immediately placed for the purchase
of rice to be stored in granaries.
(6) That the 9th cheap sale of rice be
immediately carried out by the Shanghai Rice Cheap Sale
Committee.
In order to alleviate the gravity of the
situation, the authorities and all the parties concerned
should, in spite of all difficulties, do their best to carry
out the six measures mentioned above.
P.T.O.

致《中美日报》、《正言报》、《国民新闻》、
《新晚报》及《申报》：

米价局势

尽管有大量大米运抵，但昨日米市私下交易的大米价格每石突然上涨6至7元，打破了上海每日涨幅的所有纪录。由于米蛀虫（投机商）的活动，民众的粮食供应问题已达到极其严重的阶段，除非两个外国租界当局立即采取措施，否则租界的和平与秩序将受到严重威胁。
在昨日的私下交易中，每购买100包小交米需额外支付3,400元，每购买100包一等和二等西贡米需额外支付3,200元，暹罗米需额外支付3,000元。碎米的价格已高达每石90元。简而言之，在过去两周内，每石价格上涨了20元。
造成米价大幅上涨的主要原因如下：
(1) 投机者完全无视当局拟对其采取的措施。
(2) 米业公会在调整米市事务方面缺乏足够的精力和权力。
(3) 囤积者操纵现有库存。
(4) 在不轨分子受特殊势力庇护下于米市进行采购。
因此，为了稳定米价，应尽快采取以下措施：
(1) 立即派遣便衣人员进行调查，并逮捕所有涉嫌囤积或操纵市场的人员。
(2) 强迫囤积者将其库存出售给米店，由米店零售。
(3) 加强米业团体的组织，使其能够迅速调整米市事务。
(4) 严禁外人通过不轨分子在米市采购。
(5) 利用已从各行业筹集的资金，立即下令采购大米并存入粮仓。
(6) 上海平粜委员会立即执行第九次平粜。
为了缓解局势的严重性，当局及各有关方面尽管困难重重，仍应尽力执行上述六项措施。

March 14, 1941. Morning Translation.

Cheng Yien Pao and Sin Wan Pao :-

GENERAL CHIANG KAI-SHEK ORDERS RIGOROUS SUPPRESSION OF
HOARDING OF FOOD PROVISIONS

With a view to keeping down the prices of
commodities, suppressing hoarding and profiteering and
protecting the legitimate business of bona-fide merchants,
General Chiang Kai-shek has issued an order instructing his
subordinates to enforce the following measures:-
(1) All shops, companies or individuals,
found hoarding foodstuffs and daily necessaries of life,
should be made to dispose of their goods within a specified
period to meet the requirements of the market and the people.
(2) Those who fail to dispose of their goods
voluntarily within the specified period or who fail to make a
report in accordance with the instructions will be severely
punished in accordance with Military Law.
(3) Those who dispose of their goods in
compliance with the instructions will be assured by the
Government of a legitimate profit.
(4) Bona-fide merchants are not allowed
to cease their operations, while the government will assure
them of a legitimate profit in their transactions.
(5) No person, unless he is a member of a
trade guild, will be allowed to purchase goods for hoarding
so as to protect legitimate business.

New China Daily News, Bing Pao, Central China Daily News and
Kuo Min Daily News :-

CITY GOVERNMENT TO STABILIZE PRICES OF COMMODITIES

In order to stabilize the prices of
commodities and to readjust consumption, the City Government
has ordered the Social Affairs Bureau to collect information to
be used in readjusting the control of goods. The Social
Affairs Bureau yesterday instructed its thirteen branch offices
in Nantao, etc. to carry out this order.

Cheng Yien Pao and Shun Pao :-

ANNIVERSARY OF ARRIVAL OF NATIONALIST ARMY IN SHANGHAI

March 21 will be the anniversary of the
arrival of the Nationalist Army in Shanghai in 1927. Owing to
the extraordinary conditions prevailing in Shanghai, the people
in various walks of life in this city will not hold any
ceremony to celebrate the event.
Lest undesirable elements should create
trouble on this anniversary, the Police of the two Foreign
Settlements will adopt precautionary measures for a week prior
to and immediately after the anniversary and will place a strict
ban on all meetings, processions and demonstrations, while in
addition they will strictly enforce the curfew.

致《正言报》及《新晚报》：

蒋介石将军命令严厉镇压囤积粮食行为

为了抑制物价，打击囤积居奇和哄抬物价，并保护正当商人的合法经营，蒋介石将军已发布命令，指示其下属执行以下措施：
(1) 凡发现囤积食品和生活必需品的商店、公司或个人，应责令其在规定期限内处理货物，以满足市场和人民的需求。
(2) 那些未在规定期限内自愿处理货物或未按照指令报告的人，将根据军法严惩。
(3) 那些遵照指令处理货物的人，政府将保证他们获得合法利润。
(4) 正当商人不得停止营业，政府将保证他们在交易中获得合法利润。
(5) 为了保护合法经营，除同业公会成员外，任何人不得为囤积目的购买商品。

致《新华日报》、《炳报》、《华中日报》及《国民日报》：

市政府稳定物价

为了稳定物价和调整消费，市政府已命令社会局收集信息，用于重新调整对物资的管制。社会局昨日指示其在南市等地的十三个分局执行此命令。

致《正言报》及《申报》：

国军进驻上海周年纪念

3月21日是1927年国民革命军进驻上海的周年纪念日。鉴于上海目前的非常局势，本市各界人士将不举行任何仪式庆祝这一事件。
为了防止不良分子在这一周年纪念日制造麻烦，两个外国租界的警察将在纪念日前一周及之后立即采取预防措施，严格禁止所有集会、游行和示威，此外还将严格执行宵禁。

March 14, 1941.
Morning Translation

Central China Daily News :-

EXECUTIVE COMMITTEEMAN OF P.W.D. TUNG JEN MUTUAL AID
ASSOCIATION ARRESTED : OPPRESSION BY POLICE : FALSE
ACCUSATION : SOCIAL MOVEMENT DIRECTION COMMITTEE PETITIONED
FOR ASSISTANCE

The P.W.D. Tung Jen Mutual Aid
Association (工務處同人互助會) was inaugurated on
March 2 with an office at No. 59 Jukong Road Bridge.
Yesterday Nyien Kwang-hai (嚴廣海),
a member of the Executive Committee of the Association, was
arrested by the police of the district.
It is learned that the police station
carried out this act of oppression because it believed the
false accusation made by two coolies named Hsu Hsiang-yue
(許長有) and Shao Shu-yih (邵樹業) at the instigation
of Chu Sing-san (朱丞山), a foreman of the road
construction coolies in the Western District, that Nyien
Kwang-hai was compelling the coolies to pay membership
fees.
Wang Siao-ziang (王兆祥) and other
members of the Executive Committee of the Association
yesterday petitioned the Shanghai Branch of the Social
Movement Direction Committee for assistance.

Central China Daily News :-

INAUGURATION MEETING OF FOURTH DISTRICT ORDURE COOLIES
LABOUR UNION

The Fourth District Ordure Coolies
Labour Union was inaugurated at No.10 Edinburgh Road
yesterday. Wu Foong-ziang (吳鳳祥) and Dih Chi-ming
(翟濟民), representing the Shanghai Branch of the Social
Movement Direction Committee, were present.
Zee Yoeh-zung (徐學成) and six others
were elected members of the Executive Committee, Zao Jeng-
ching (趙鏡卿) and two others as reserve members, Wu Chi-
lai (吳芝來) and four others as members of the Supervisory
Committee and Ying Foong-lou (殷鳳樓) and some others as
reserve members.

Shun Pao, Cheng Yien Pao, Chinese-American Daily News, Sin
Wan Pao and National Herald :-

A.B.C. PRESS WORKERS ON STRIKE

Owing to the high cost of living, the
100 workers of the A.B.C. Press, a German concern, on
Szechuen Road the other day submitted to their management
two demands, namely :-
(1) That they be granted an increase of $10, and
(2) That they be issued with ½ picul of rice.
At first the management promised to
consider the demands, but yesterday it announced that the
demands could not be accepted. The workers declared a
strike at 2.30 p.m. yesterday.

P. T. O.

March 14, 1941.
Morning Translation

Chinese-American Daily News :-

THE GAMBLING AND OPIUM DENS

Whether the gambling resorts, opium smoking dens and other illegal enterprises such as the mortgaging of pawn tickets, etc. in the Western District will be suppressed following the inauguration of the Special Police Force in the Western District is a matter that is creating serious consideration among local residents.
According to information secured by this paper yesterday, it is said that in accordance with the provisions of the agreement for the establishment of a Special Police Force, the gaming houses and opium dens must be suppressed. However, owing to the fact that the Force has not yet started functioning, no detailed arrangements for the suppression of these establishments have been made.
With the exception of the large gambling dens which are still operating, the smaller gambling resorts and opium dens along Bubbling Well Road and Woo Ping Road (和平路) have all closed. Some have even removed their fittings and furniture.
It is believed, however, that six of the gambling establishments in Nantao will resume operations shortly.

Shun Pao and Sin Wan Pao :-

THE ABDUCTION OF TING CHUNG YING.

According to information disclosed by his family, Ting Chung-ying (丁仲英), who was abducted on February 24 outside his residence, was held by his kidnappers near Lunghwa but later was removed to Pootung.
Acting on information received, the authorities the other day raided the kidnappers' den and rescued Ting Chung-ying who, after being questioned at the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters in the Western District, was allowed to return home yesterday.

Central China Daily News (Advertisement) :-

Ting Chung-ying expresses his thanks

Ting Chung-ying publishes a notice expressing thanks to Ting Shih-san (丁世三) and Li Shih-yu (李世宇), Commander and Vice Commander of the 13th Army Division, for rescuing him from the hands of his kidnappers.

致《中美日报》：

赌场与鸦片烟馆

随着西区特别警察队的成立，西区的赌场、鸦片烟馆以及其他非法企业（如当票抵押等）是否会遭到取缔，这是当地居民严重关注的问题。
据本报昨日获悉的消息，据说根据建立特别警察队协议的条款，必须取缔赌场和鸦片烟馆。然而，由于该警察队尚未开始运作，因此尚未对这些场所的取缔做出详细安排。
除了仍在运营的大型赌窟外，静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）和和平路（Woo Ping Road）沿线的小型赌场和鸦片烟馆均已关闭。有些甚至拆除了装置和家具。
然而，据信南市的六家赌场不久将恢复营业。

致《申报》及《新晚报》：

丁仲英绑架案

据其家属披露的信息，2月24日在其住所外被绑架的丁仲英 (Ting Chung-ying)，最初被绑匪拘禁在龙华附近，随后被转移至浦东。
当局根据收到的情报，日前突袭了绑匪巢穴，解救了丁仲英。他在西区日本宪兵队总部接受讯问后，于昨日获准回家。

致《华中日报》（广告）：

丁仲英致谢

丁仲英刊登启事，感谢第十三师师长丁世三 (Ting Shih-san) 和副师长李世宇 (Li Shih-yu) 将其从绑匪手中救出。

SUBJECT: P.W.D. - strike of Road Construction Coolies.

The 65 Road Construction Coolies attached to
the Dixwell Road Depot, F.W.D., who struck work
on the mornings of the 7th and 8th of March, when
the P.W.D. Authorities were unable to find work for all
who reported at the depot and refused to give them
a guarantee of permanent employment in the Northern
Area, resumed work unconditionally at 6 a.m. March 10th.

These coolies have already been informed by
the P.W.D. Authorities that they will receive no
wages for the 7th and 8th of March when they were
on strike. About 351 road construction coolies
employed in the Eastern and Central Districts and
attached to the Gordon Road Depot, who had already
commenced work but were later intimidated into
joining the strike on the morning of 8th March, also
resumed work unconditionally at 6 a.m., March 10th.

The P.W.D. authorities consider that these
coolies who were intimidated into striking, should
not be penalized, therefore arrangements are being
made to pay them either a half or a full day's wages
for March 8th.

Wages will be paid to all these road construction
coolies (numbering about 500 including those employed
in the Northern Area who instigated the strike), at
the Soochow Road Depot at 5 p.m. on Wednesday March 12th.

Made by D.S.I. Loh Wei Long Forwarded by C. D. I. Fabrum

During the afternoon of February 20, one
HSU ZANG YEU ( 徐長友 ), Road Construction Coolie
No. 210 (previously No. 266), attached to the
Shunteh Road Depot of the Public Works Department,
was assaulted by two dismissed coolies on Shunteh
Road. He was accused of having failed to assist
them in organizing a labour union and further with
having instigated other coolies to refuse payment of
membership fees. The assault was witnessed by
P.W.D. coolie No. 221 (previously No. 270).
According to the victim, the assault was later
reported to Sinza Station. Statements of HSU
ZANG YEU and the witness ZAO TSO PAO ( 曹左寶 )
are attached hereto.

The so-called "P.W.D. Coolies' Union" is
known to be in the course of formation. It is
sponsored and prompted by the "Shanghai Branch
of the Social Movement Direction Committee", 527
Range Road, but the offices of the union have not
yet been formally established.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of HSU ZANG YEU ( 許長友 )
native of Kompo taken by me D.S.I. Loh Wei Kong
at Police H.Q. on the 26.2.41 G.D.C.-362
and interpreted by

My name is HSU ZANG YEU, alias SAN LAN TSE ( 三癩子 ).
I am a native of Kompo, aged 36, married, residing at 18
Yih Ka Zah (Chinese bungalow), west of Yenping Road. I
have been employed as a road construction coolie, Badge
No. 210 (formerly No. 266) in the Shunteh Road Depot,
P.W.D. for the past nineteen years.

At 10 a.m., February 3, 1941, I was working on
Chungking Road near Race Course Road, when I was approached
by NYI PAO FAH ( 倪寶發 ) and SZE SHUH TSE ( 施叔仔 ),
two dismissed coolies of the P.W.D. who asked me to join a
P.W.D. coolies' union. ( I do not know the address of the
union but it is said that same is located in an upstairs
room of a hot water shop on Paoshing Road, near the market,
Chapei). They told me that some 190 coolies had already
joined the union. They suggested appointing me as a
representative and if I agreed, they would hold me
responsible for collecting membership fees on their behalf.
I rejected their request and told them that, if it was
discovered by my foreign superior officer that I had joined
a union, I would be discharged. They advised me to consider
the matter and departed.

At 4.30 p.m., February 13, 1941, I was again approached
by NYI PAO FAH and SZE SHUH TSE who inquired if I had collected
membership fees on their behalf from the coolies. I replied
in the negative, whereupon NYI PAO FAH warned me to make
collections without further delay before our next meeting.
(i.e. Thursday, February 20).

以下是我副探长罗伟孔 ( Loh Wei Kong ) 于1941年2月26日在警察总部对籍贯为Kompo的许长友 ( HSU ZANG YEU ) 取得的陈述，G.D.C.-362，并由____翻译

我叫许长友 ( HSU ZANG YEU )，别名三癞子 ( SAN LAN TSE )。
我是Kompo人，现年36岁，已婚，居住在延平路西侧义加扎（中式平房）18号。过去十九年来，我一直在工务局顺德路堆栈受雇为道路建筑苦力，徽章编号210（原编号266）。

1941年2月3日上午10时，我正在跑马厅路附近的重庆路工作，这时两名工务局被解雇的苦力倪宝发 ( NYI PAO FAH ) 和施叔仔 ( SZE SHUH TSE ) 走近我，要求我加入工务局苦力工会。（我不知道工会的地址，但据说位于闸北市场附近宝兴路一家热水店楼上的房间里）。他们告诉我，已有约190名苦力加入了工会。他们建议任命我为代表，如果我同意，他们将让我负责代他们收取会费。我拒绝了他们的要求，并告诉他们，如果我的外籍上司发现我加入了工会，我就会被解雇。他们劝我考虑一下此事，然后离开了。

1941年2月13日下午4时30分，倪宝发和施叔仔再次接近我，询问我是否已代他们从苦力那里收取了会费。我回答没有，于是倪宝发警告我在下次会面（即2月20日星期四）之前不要再拖延，尽快收款。

10M-1-40

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of _________________________________
native of ______________________ taken by me ____________________
at _________________ on the ______________ and interpreted by ______

- 2 -

At 4.30 p.m., February 20, I again met NYI PAO FAH
and SZU SHUH TSE at Shunteh and Markham Roads corssing
when they again questioned me regarding the collection
of membership fees. I replied that as I myself had not
joined the union, they could not expect me to collect
the membership fees from others on their behalf. Upon
hearing this, NYI PAO FAH suddenly accused me of owing him
$1.00. He and SZU SHUH TSE struck me on the face resulting
in my face becoming swollen. Subsequently they took
me to the Hwa Shing Lur ( 華興樓 ) Teashop at Shunteh
Road where SZU SHUH TSE made the following remarks:
"You are far from being good. You have failed to pay
the membership fees due, and you further instigated others
to refuse payment. If things continue like this, some
day later, you will be killed." Before departing,
NYI PAO FAH stated : "You may report to your superior
if you wish but the worst we can get is only one week's
detention, but you take care regarding your own safety."
I then left the teashop and proceeded to the P.W.D. Depot,
92 Shunteh Road to receive my wages.

As I was afraid of being killed, I did not report
the matter to my superior until 8.30 p.m. February 22
(Saturday), when I made a report to a foreigner attached
to the depot. He accompanied me to Sinza Station and
reported the matter to the Police. The above is my true
statement.

Thumb printed : HSU ZANG YEU

警方调查报告。

以下是____的陈述，籍贯____，由我____于____在____取得，并由____翻译

- 2 -

2月20日下午4时30分，我在顺德路和麦根路路口再次遇到倪宝发和施叔仔 ( SZU SHUH TSE )，他们再次就收取会费一事质问我。我回答说，既然我自己都没有加入工会，他们就不能指望我代他们向其他人收取会费。听到这话，倪宝发突然指责我欠他1.00美元。他和施叔仔打了我的脸，导致我的脸肿胀。随后，他们把我带到顺德路的华兴楼 ( Hwa Shing Lur ) 茶馆，施叔仔说了以下的话：“你很不识相。你没有缴纳应付的会费，还煽动他人拒绝缴费。如果事情继续这样下去，总有一天你会被杀掉。”离开前，倪宝发说：“如果你愿意，你可以向上司报告，但我们最坏的结果也只是拘留一周，不过你要小心自己的安全。”随后我离开茶馆，前往顺德路92号的工务局堆栈领取工资。

由于害怕被杀，直到2月22日（星期六）晚上8时30分，我才向上司报告此事，当时我向堆栈的一名外籍人员作了报告。他陪我去了新闸捕房，并向警方报告了此事。以上是我的真实陈述。

按指印：许长友 ( HSU ZANG YEU )

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT
Date February 22 1941.
Subject F.W.D. - road construction coolies' partial strike settled.
Made by D. I. Kao Yen Ken Forwarded by C.J.I. Tabrum

The seventy-one road construction coolies
(Northern Division) of the Soochow Road Depot,
F.W.D., who went on strike on February 21, resumed
work at 6.30 a.m. February 22.
Two delegates of these strikers, No. 267
Chen Ching Ts (陳慶芝) and No. 474 Chu Tseng
Ling (朱正林) called at F.W.D. Head Office
at 3.30 p.m. February 21, where it was decided
to transfer ten of the coolies to Yangtsepoo Depot,
so that the remaining 61 coolies would be able to
secure daily employment at Soochow Road Depot.
It was also agreed that the 71 striking coolies be
given one-third of a day's pay for February 21, the
day on which they went on strike.

S.I. Special Branch.
February 21, 1941.

P. W. - part of road construction
coolies on strike.
------------------------------------
Seventy-one road construction coolies (Northern Division)
of the Soochow Road Depot, P.W.D., went on strike at 6.30 a.m.
February 21 to enforce demands for better treatment.
At the Soochow Road Depot, there are two divisions of road
construction coolies, 54 of whom belong to the Central Division
and 71 of whom belong to the Northern Division. They are all
issued with badges bearing numbers.
Regarding the Northern Division, prior to 1936 there were
about 200 coolies so employed but later owing to the Council's
retrenchment policy and the subsequent closing of the Northern
Division Depot on Thorne Road it was decided by the P.W.D. not
to re-issue 129 of these badges, thereby dispensing with the servi-
ces of 129 coolies. The balance of 71 badges were transferred to
the Central Division Depot. The 200 coolies formerly employed at
the Northern Division Depot followed the transfer of the 71 badges
and have since been sharing these 71 badges between them with the
result that each cooli is able to work only about two days a
week. This practice when compared with coolies attached to the
Central Depot is to them unsatisfactory in that the latter have
daily employment. With a view to obtaining some consideration
into these alleged grievances, the 71 striking coolies issued
with badges this morning attended P.W.D. Headquarters.
Representatives of the striking coolies have requested
Special Branch mediation. The situation is being watched.

Certified true copy

1941年2月21日。

工务局 - 部分筑路苦力罢工。
---
工务局苏州路堆栈北区71名筑路苦力于2月21日上午6时30分罢工，以强制要求改善待遇。
在苏州路堆栈，筑路苦力分为两个区，其中54人属于中区，71人属于北区。他们均获发带有编号的徽章。
关于北区，1936年以前受雇于此的苦力约有200人，但后来由于工部局的紧缩政策以及随后关闭位于Thorne Road（音译）的北区堆栈，工务局决定不再补发其中的129枚徽章，从而解除了129名苦力的服务。剩余的71枚徽章被转移至中区堆栈。原先受雇于北区堆栈的200名苦力跟随这71枚徽章的转移，此后一直共同分享这71枚徽章，导致每名苦力每周仅能工作约两天。与隶属于中区堆栈的苦力相比，这种做法令他们感到不满，因为后者拥有每日工作机会。为了促使当局对这些所谓的冤屈予以考虑，今晨持有徽章罢工的71名苦力前往工务局总部。
罢工苦力代表已请求特别股进行调解。目前正对该局势保持监视。

Some 200 garbage boat coolies in the employ
of some 47 F.W.D. garbage boats along the
following jetties, namely,
1. Shantung Road Jetty,
2. Fukien Road Jetty,
3. Kanchu Road Jetty,

for an increase of 60% of their wages.

is one Ma Hoong Kee (馬鴻記) with an office
at No. 10, Lane 60, Soo Zung Li (蘇潤里), Amoy
Road. These boats are divided into three
classes, they are (1) 1st class, (2) 2nd class
and (3) 3rd class, employing about 4, 3 and 2
coolies respectively. The Contractor pays a
monthly salary of $146 for a 1st class boat, $120
for a 2nd class boat and $114 for a 3rd class boat.

grant the following :-

1.

Alleged threatened attack on P.W.D. Labour Superviser

At 11.50p.m. 20/3/41, Insp. Holt P.W.D. telephoned
to the station and reported that he had received informa-
tion that an attack would be made by some armed men on
299/6 Seymour Road at 5a.m. 21/3/41.
At 4.40a.m. 21/3/41, D.S.I. Cooper, C.D.3. 163,
C.D.C. 314 and C.D.C. 304 attended the vicinity of the
place and posted themselves in concealed positions and
waited. P.P.C. Drury and 6 C.P.C.s arranged themselves
at alleyway entrances to the north and south of the
above lane along Seymour Road. Nothing untoward took
place.
Enquiries by D.S.I. Cooper and C.D.C. 314 revealed
that P.W.D. Labour Supervisor Ts Zung San (朱承山)
Shunteh Road Depot, residing at 299/6 Seymour Road had
on two occasions received a threatening letter. The
first letter about 2 months ago and the 2nd. about 1
month ago. Both referred to him being the cause of
preventing P.W.D. Coolies from joining a certain labour
union, and that if he still continued to do this he
would be endangering his life.
These letters were handed in to Sinza Station.
Three weeks ago, two male Chinese named Nyi Pao Fah
(嚴宝芳 and Huh Nyi Too (黑耳朵) together with a

涉嫌威胁攻击工务局劳工监工

1941年3月20日晚上11时50分，工务局霍尔特督察致电巡捕房报告称，他收到情报，称一些武装人员将于1941年3月21日凌晨5时在西摩路299/6号发动袭击。
1941年3月21日凌晨4时40分，副督察 Cooper（音译），C.D.3. 163，C.D.C. 314 和 C.D.C. 304 到达该地点附近，埋伏在隐蔽位置等待。P.P.C. Drury（音译）和6名 C.P.C.s（音译，可能指中国籍巡长或类似职级）在西摩路上述弄堂南北两侧的巷口布置就位。未发生任何异常事件。
经副督察 Cooper（音译）和 C.D.C. 314 调查查明，工务局劳工监工朱承山（Shunteh Road Depot，音译：顺泰路堆栈），居住在西摩路299/6号，曾两次收到恐吓信。第一封信大约在2个月前，第二封大约在1个月前。两封信都提到他是阻止工务局苦力加入某个工会的原因，并称如果他继续这样做，将会危及他的生命。
这些信件已提交给新闸巡捕房。三周前，两名名为严宝芳和黑耳朵的中国男子连同一名

Gordon Road Police    Misc    208/41    June 8th, 1941.

Strike at P.W.D. Depot, North Yenping Road.

Sir,

At 6.45 a.m. 6-6-41, a telephone message was received at Gordon Road Station from Mr. Thornz, in charge of the P.W.D. Depot, North Yenping Road, reporting that a number of coolies had ceased work.

A party of police, under the Officer-in-charge, immediately rushed to the scene, where it was learned that some 900 highway coolies, carpenters, bricklayers and stone-crushers had ceased work.

Enquiries revealed that, on the 5-6-41, Mr. Thornz had ordered a squad of workers under Chinese Foreman No. 56 Kau Pang Zai (高邦才) to complete a repair job on Changping Road near Hart Road on that date. The workers failed to complete the work, and this resulted in Mr. Thornz dismissing the foreman.

When the employees reported for work this A.M., they went on strike in protest against the dismissal of the foreman.

A large party of Police has been posted at the scene, and so far no untoward incident has occurred.

The strikers have presented a demand for the reinstatement of the dismissed foreman.

D.O. and D.D.O. "B" Division, and Special Branch informed.

Attempt to Form Union by P.W.D. Coolies.

On 27/12/40 Mr. Holt, Inspector, P.W.D. Shunteh Road
Depot, reported to Chief Inspector Blenkinsop, Officer
i/c, that a P.W.D. Coolie No. 196, Nyi Pau Fah (倪保法) ✓
who had been dismissed on the morning of 27/12/40 for a
misdemeanour, intended to open a room in the Yoong Oen
Lodging House, 104 Shunteh Road between 6 p.m. and 7 p.m.
on 27/12/40 for the purpose of forming a Union of P.W.D.
Coolies. The Special Branch was informed of this by
C.I. Blenkinsop, and C.D.C. 326 (Special Branch) was
detailed to investigate.

At 6.10 p.m. on 27/12/40 S.I. Bradley and C.D.C.25
visited Room 22 of the Yoong Oen Lodging House, in which
they found the four under-described male Chinese, who
were brought to this station:- ✓

on the Soochow Creek.

documents relating to the formation of a P.W.D. Coolies
Union.

1.

<u>P.W.D. Shunteh Road Depot Transportation
Coolies - Short - Stoppage of Work.</u>

At 7 a.m. 11-12-40, a telephone message was
received at this station from the P.W.D. Shunteh Road
Depot reporting that the 400 transportation coolies
refused to start work in opposition to a decision of
the P.W.D. Authorities to change their numbers.

A party of uniform police and C.D.S. 67 attended
and from enquiries made, the following was ascertained:-

There are a total of 1450 highway construction
coolies and 400 transportation workers in Shunteh Road
Depot and they are numbered under two separate sections,
each section beginning with number one.

On the morning of 11-12-40, the P.W.D. Authorities
announced that in order to unify the numbers of the
workers, the transportation workers, with effect from
today, would be numbered as from No. 1451 following
the highway construction coolies instead of from No.
1 under their own section.

The new system of numbering was opposed by the
transportation workers on the ground that workers of
P.W.D. bearing higher numbers were usually discharged
first whenever the P.W.D. enforced a reduction of staff
and they, therefore, refused to start work.

However, at 9 a.m. same date, the P.W.D. Authorities
agreed to retain the old system of numbering and as a
result all transportation workers resumed operation at
9.20 a.m. in an orderly manner.

<u>工务局顺泰路堆场运输苦力——短暂停工。</u>

1940年12月11日上午7时，本警署接到工务局顺泰路堆场电话报告，称400名运输苦力为反对工务局当局更改其编号的决定，拒绝开工。

一队制服警察及第67号中国侦缉队（C.D.S.）警员前往处理，经查询，查明情况如下：-

顺泰路堆场共有筑路苦力1450名和运输工人400名，他们分属两个独立部门进行编号，每个部门的编号均从一号开始。

1940年12月11日上午，工务局当局宣布，为统一工人编号，自即日起，运输工人的编号将接在筑路苦力之后，从第1451号开始，而非按其原部门从第1号开始。

运输工人反对这一新编号制度，理由是工务局持有较大编号的工人通常在工务局实施裁员时会被优先解雇，因此他们拒绝开工。

然而，同日早上9时，工务局当局同意保留旧的编号制度，结果所有运输工人于上午9时20分有序复工。

December 11, 1940.
Public Works Department - unrest among transport coolies.

At 6 a.m. to-day, December 11, some 270 transport
coolies attached to Shunteh Road Depot of the Public
Works Department, refused to work in protest against
a change of badges. Enquiries reveal that the
Transport Department has been recently abolished,
following a reorganization, and the P.W.D. Authorities
have placed these workers under the control of a new
section to be known as the "Material Supply Section"
attached to the Highways Department. In addition to
the 1450 badges issued to road construction coolies
of the Highways Department, it has been decided that
the transport coolies be re-numbered, the numbers
beginning from No.1451, with new badges. The coolies
affected are opposed to these arrangements and have
refused to accept the new badges and did not commence
operation until 10 a.m. They resumed work on being
informed that the decision of changing the badges
would be shelved for the time being, but they also
demanded that they be permitted to work on Sundays
or receive half pay should they not be given work.
According to the transport coolies, they will not
receive payment for Sundays in consequence of this
new reorganization, and this issue remains unsettled.
The coolies have been instructed to submit written
appeals to the P.W.D. authorities.

（批：Copy sent to Secy. & Finance - Secy
vide Main File (12-12-40)）

1940年12月11日。
工务局——运输苦力骚动。

今日，12月11日上午6时，隶属于工务局顺泰路堆场的约270名运输苦力为抗议更换胸牌而拒绝工作。经查，运输处最近因重组而被撤销，工务局当局将这些工人置于公路处下属一个名为“材料供应股”的新部门管辖之下。除了已发给公路处筑路苦力的1450个胸牌外，当局决定对运输苦力重新编号，号码从第1451号开始，并发放新胸牌。受影响的苦力反对这些安排，拒绝接受新胸牌，直到上午10时才开始作业。在得知更换胸牌的决定暂时搁置后，他们恢复了工作，但他们还要求允许他们在星期日工作，或者如果不给他们工作安排，则应支付半薪。据运输苦力称，由于这次新的重组，他们将无法获得星期日的工资，这一问题仍未解决。已指示苦力向工务局当局提交书面申诉。

（批：副本已送秘书长兼财务秘书，见主卷宗 (12-12-40)）

TRANSLATION OF A PETITION ADDRESSED TO THE SPECIAL
BRANCH, S.M. POLICE, FROM P.W.D. ROAD CONSTRUCTION
COOLIES.

December 2, 1940.

To Special Branch,
S.M. Police.

Dear Sire,

Following the outbreak of the local
Sino-Japanese hostilities, the number of
"workmen's badges" for each district has been
reduced by two-thirds. Therefore, one badge is
being shared by three men. In other words, one
man can get only one day's work in every three
days. Such a state of affairs is probably
unknown to our superiors.

Unexpectedly we have now learned that
a number of us are to be dismissed. In good
weather when work can be done, we are given
neither work nor pay. This is against the
existing rules of the P.W.D. i.e. we should
receive pay irrespective of whether there is
work or not in the case of good weather, while in rainy
weather when work cannot be done, we are given
half pay. How is it that we are not given pay on fine
days? We are inclined to believe that some
unscrupulous elements are effecting a "monopoly"
and oppressing us.

As regards the Tatung Road and Markham
Roads districts, there are indications that the
regular road construction coolies are to be
temporarily suspended from work and that new hands
will be employed. In Soochow Road District,
14 old hands have been discharged. Were it not
for the sake of peace and order, we would have
page_data.zh:
工务局筑路苦力致上海公共租界工部局警务处特别处的请愿书译文。

1940年12月2日。

致特别处，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

尊敬的阁下：

自本地中日战事爆发以来，各区的“工人胸牌”数量减少了三分之二。因此，现在三人共用一个胸牌。换句话说，一个人每三天只能得到一天的工作。这种状况上级可能并不知晓。

出乎意料的是，我们现在得知我们中的一些人将被解雇。在天气良好可以工作时，我们既没有工作也没有工资。这违反了工务局的现行规定，即：在天气良好时，无论是否有工作，我们都应获得工资；而在雨天无法工作时，我们获得半薪。为什么在晴天我们不发工资？我们倾向于相信是一些不法分子在进行“垄断”并压迫我们。

至于大通路 (Tatung Road) 和麦根路 (Markham Roads) 地区，有迹象表明正式的筑路苦力将被暂时停职，并将雇佣新手。在苏州路 (Soochow Road) 地区，14名老工人已被解雇。如果不是为了和平与秩序，我们本来会

page_data.en:
declared a strike as a protest against such
injustice.
We now request your department to consider
our difficulties and suppress the irregularities
as mentioned above. We also beg to inform you
that foreman Zee Mei Sung ( 徐梅生 ) of the
Soochow Road Section, has employed a thief named
Yuan Tuh Zeu ( 袁德森 ) as foreman No.G.38.
All coolies have shown that dissatisfaction over
is
this matter and this/the reason for the dismissal of
road construction coolies. Yuan Tuh Zeu alias
Yuan Lau Sz ( 袁老四 ) was arrested by "Hailen" at
Kashing Road Bridge in 1938 for larceny and sentenced
to imprisonment. After his release, he now was made
a foreman. We feel indignant over this matter and
request you to look into it.

Signed by Zao Van Hwa and 46 others.
page_data.zh:
宣布罢工以抗议这种不公。
现在我们请求贵部门考虑我们的困难，并制止上述违规行为。我们还要告知您，苏州路段的工头徐梅生 (Zee Mei Sung) 雇佣了一名名叫袁德森 (Yuan Tuh Zeu) 的小偷担任G.38号工头。所有苦力都对此事表示不满，这也是筑路苦力被解雇的原因。袁德森，又名袁老四 (Yuan Lau Sz)，曾于1938年在嘉兴路桥被“海伦” (Hailen) 逮捕，因盗窃罪被判入狱。获释后，他现在竟被任命为工头。我们对此事感到愤慨，请求您进行调查。

赵万华 (Zao Van Hwa) 及其他46人签名。

Made by ____ and ____ Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

At 6.15 a.m., to-day, November 20, the
674 scavengers attached to the Markham Road Depot
of the Cleansing Division of the Public Works
Department refused to work as a protest against
the dismissal of their colleagues. A number of
them entered the offices and damaged several window
panes, but further trouble was averted by the
Municipal Police who arrested three of the coolies
believed to be agitators.

Enquiries reveal that the services of
eighteen coolies were dispensed with on November
19 and 20, and a further thirty are to be discharged.
This discharge it is reported is being done in order
to curtail expenses. The coolies, however, are
opposed to such action, and hold Mr. A.D. Pavlovsky,
in charge of the Markham Road Depot as being
responsible for the dismissal. They have made the
following demands :

(1) That the discharged coolies be reinstated,
and that no further dismissals be made.

(2) That the three arrested coolies be released.

(3) That Mr. A.D. Pavlovsky, in charge of the
Markham Road Depot, be transferred.

At 10.35 a.m. Inspector Trodd in charge of
Gordon Road Station stated that the Head Office
through Mr. Harbottle had agreed to the release
of the three coolies detained but the coolies must
first resume work and consideration will be given

Sir,

by the strikers, the S.M.C./P.W.D. conceded the

Sir,

received at Gordon Road Station from S.M.D./P.W.D.
Markham Road Depot, 838 Markham Road, reporting that
the coolies had refused to start work and that a riot
was in progress.

A party of police under the Officer i/c responded
to the scene, and upon arrival found a large number of
coolies attacking the offices of the Depot, and
observed that damage had been caused to windows, doors
and the windscreen of a P.W.D. truck, total damage estimated
at $300.00.

The party dispersed the crowd and apprehended

(2) Tsao Tze Yuan (朱志元) and (3) Tsang Aying
Vey (張金萬), in the act of causing damage.

Inquiries ascertained that the P.W.D. have
arranged, as a measure of economy, to discharge forty
eight of the cleaning coolies (casual labour) employed
at the Markham Road Depot. On the 19-11-1940, fourteen
of the coolies were discharged, and it was arranged
to dispense with the services of a further four this
morning. However, when the 462 coolies attended for
work this A.M., they suddenly attacked the office, in
which Inspector A.D. Pavlovsky, i/c of the Depot, was
present at the time.

The strikers subsequently presented three demands,
as follows:-
(1) Re-instatement of the eighteen dismissed

先生：

1940年11月20日上午8时10分，戈登路警署接到上海公共租界工部局/工务处马克姆路堆栈（马克姆路838号）的电话报告，称苦力拒绝开工，且正在发生骚乱。

由主管警官率领的一队警察赶赴现场，到达后发现大量苦力正在攻击堆栈办公室，并观察到窗户、门和一辆工务处卡车的挡风玻璃遭到破坏，估计损失总额为300.00美元。

该队警察驱散了人群，并逮捕了三名正在实施破坏行为的苦力，姓名分别为 (1) 朱文湯 (Tsao Wen Yang)，(2) 朱志元 (Tsao Tze Yuan) 和 (3) 張金萬 (Tsang Aying Vey)。

经查询得知，工务处出于节约措施，安排解雇受雇于马克姆路堆栈的四十八名清洁苦力（临时工）。1940年11月19日，十四名苦力被解雇，并安排于今天上午再解雇四名。然而，当这462名苦力于今天上午上班时，他们突然袭击了办公室，当时堆栈主管A.D. 帕夫洛夫斯基（Pavlovsky）巡官在场。

罢工者随后提出了三项要求，如下：-

At 7:25 a.m. 28.9.40., S.P.C.209 & C.P.C.3095
brought to Pootoo Road Station the following persons:-

1. Sih Foo Kwei (薛富貴), 19, Honan, S/P.W.D.
Transport Coolie No.267, living at 3856 pah
Hsu Li, Robison Road.

2. Kwei Yang Tsau Te (桂楊草), 23, Kompo, M/*.
P.W.D.Coolie No.389, straw hut off Singapore
Road near Kiaochow Road.

These two men were arrested on Robison Road
near Gordon Road, when they and about 20 other coolies
called upon two coolies pushing P.W.D. garbage carts
Nos. W26 and V90 to strike. The garbage cart coolies
refused to, whereupon the crowd of strikers, led by
the two arrested men, pulled a wheel off Cart No.W26
and overturned it, whilst a leg was knocked off Cart
No.V90. The garbage cart coolies did not come to the
station, but their names are Miau San (苗二) and
Woo Pah (吳大) respectively.

The two arrested men stated that at 4:30 a.m.
28.9.40., they, in a crowd of about 300, went to
Shanteh Road Depot to see if the Highway Department
coolies were returning to work. As they were not,
the two arrested men and about 20 others decided to
go to Robison Road to see if garbage coolies were
working. When they got to Robison Road near Gordon
Road, they tried to persuade and then intimidate (as
reported) two garbage coolies to strike.

On the instructions of the D.O."B", both men
have been charged and will appear before the S.S.D.
Court on 1.10.40.

这两名男子在罗宾森路靠近戈登路处被捕，当时他们和大约20名其他苦力怂恿两名推着工务处垃圾车（编号W26和V90）的苦力罢工。垃圾车苦力拒绝后，由两名被捕男子带领的罢工人群拆下了W26号车的一个轮子并将其推翻，同时撞断了V90号车的一条腿。垃圾车苦力未前往警署，但其姓名分别为苗二 (Miau San) 和吳大 (Woo Pah)。

两名被捕男子陈述，1940年9月28日凌晨4:30，他们混在约300人的群体中，前往山德路（Shanteh Road）堆栈，查看公路局苦力是否复工。由于他们未复工，两名被捕男子和另外约20人决定前往罗宾森路，查看垃圾苦力是否在工作。当他们到达罗宾森路靠近戈登路处时，他们试图劝说并随后恐吓（如报告所述）两名垃圾苦力罢工。

LOUIA
28th Sept. 40.

Labour unrest

D.S.I. Wilkinson

Sir,

At 9.25 a.m. on the 27-9-40 a telephone message was received from Mr. Rose, P.W.D. stating that an attempt had been made to overturn a P.W.D. ordure cart on Yu Ya Ching Road near Burkill Road. A party of Police attended the scene and found one cart the axle pin of which had been removed.

No information was obtained that would establish the identity of the perpetrator.

At 6.25 a.m. on the 28-9-40, a further telephone message was received requesting an escort for coolies employed by the P.W.D. who were washing roads in various parts of Louza District where ordure carts had been overturned. Escort supplied.

Enquiries revealed that during curfew hours, the contents of ordure carts had been spilled onto the roadways as under:

Fokien - Ningpo Roads.
Peking Road - Soong Ka Loong.
Peking Road - Koo Ka Loong.
Hanking - Fokien Roads.
Hoopah - Kiukiang Roads.
Hankow - Shanse Roads.

No information was obtained but it would appear to be the work of agitators or strikers.

Date October 12, 1940.

REPORT

Subject Public Works Department -coolies granted increase in rice
allowance.
Made by D.S.I. Loh Wei Kong Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

The coolies of the Public Works Department,
who are paid on a daily basis have been granted an
increase of 18 cents in their rice allowance. This
sum includes the three cents offered on September 27,
by the Public Works Department while the remaining
fifteen cents will be retroactive from October 3.
Those benefiting by this increase include the road
construction coolies, scavengers, carpenters and
painters and they received their wages and allowances
including the new increase on October 11.

It will be remembered that on September 27,
the P.W.D. authorities agreed to grant an increase of
three cents, but the workers were not satisfied with
the offer, and a number of coolies agitated for more
the same day but the majority resumed normal work on
September 30. A petition was later submitted to the
P.W.D. authorities applying for better treatment and
with the granting of this increase in the rice allowance,
the coolies appear to be satisfied and the situation
in the Public Works Department is normal at present.

It is believed that the workers who are on a
monthly basis will also be granted an increase in their
rice allowances.

报告

事由：工务局——苦力获准增加米贴。
由 侦探副督察 Loh Wei Kong 制作，由 侦探督察 Crawford 转呈

按日计薪的工务局苦力，其米贴已增加18分。此金额包括工务局于9月27日提供的3分，其余15分将追溯至10月3日生效。受益于此次增加的包括筑路苦力、清道夫、木匠和油漆工，他们已于10月11日领取了包含新增部分的工资和津贴。

需指出的是，9月27日，工务局当局同意增加3分，但工人对该提议不满意，当日有部分苦力煽动要求更多，但大多数人于9月30日恢复正常工作。随后向工务局当局提交了一份请愿书，要求改善待遇。随着此次米贴的增加，苦力们似乎感到满意，目前工务局的局势正常。

据信，按月计薪的工人也将获得米贴增加。

Subject Public Works Department - Situation.

Made by D.S.I. Loh Wei Kong Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

The coolies employed by the Public Works
Department of the S.M.C. are working as usual.
According to information obtained from
certain coolies, a petition containing the following
demands has been submitted to the P.W.D. authorities for
consideration :
1. That the wages of coolies be increased from $1.16
to $2.00 per day.
2. That the coolies be allowed to purchase one picul
of rice a month from the P.W.D. authorities at
the cheap rate of $30.
3. That each coolie be issued with a raincoat which
shall be changed every year.
4. That the coolies be paid normal wages for holidays
and that those who operate on holidays be granted
double pay.
5. That an annual bonus equal to one month's pay be
issued at the end of a year.
No reply has yet been given by the P.W.D. authorities
to these demands. The coolies are reported to have
the intention of causing agitation if no satisfaction
is obtained before the end of this week.

上海公共租界工务局雇用的苦力正照常工作。
根据从某些苦力处获得的情报，已向工务局当局提交了一份包含以下要求的请愿书以供考虑：
1. 苦力的日工资从1.16元增加至2.00元。
2. 允许苦力以30元的低价每月从工务局当局购买一担大米。

The 600 road construction coolies and some
300 transport workers attached to Shunteh Road Depot of
the Public Works Department reported for duty this
morning, October 1. The transport workers commenced
work and are still working but the majority of the
road construction coolies are unable to work because
of the inclement weather and were permitted to leave
the Depot with half pay.

The 680 garbage coolies attached to the Markham
Road Depot are working this morning. While half of
the 126 workers attached to the Buildings Department,
753 Gordon Road, resumed work, this morning, the other
half are unable to carry out their duties because of
the rainy weather.

At about 8 a.m. to-day, October 1, a garbage
cart coolie No.39 attached to the Markham Road Depot
was intimidated by three unknown male Chinese reported
to have been armed with pistols, while he was carrying
out his work in an alleyway of Penang Road.

No formal demands have been submitted by the
agitating coolies, but the P.W.D. authorities offered
an increase of three cents a day at the commencement of
the agitation but the coolies are reported to have
ignored the offer. It is now learned that the workers
intend appointing representatives to open negotiation
with the P.W.D. authorities.

Further re Strike at Shunteh Road
P.W.D. Depôt.

At 8-15 a.m. on 30/9/40, a large number of coolies, believed to be attached to the Markham Road P.W.D. Depot, attempted to force their way into the Shunteh Road Depot by ramming a handcart against the gate. A party of police from this station proceeded to the depot, and on their arrival the crowd dispersed. This incident caused the coolies who had reported for work to leave the depot, but they returned later and resumed their duties.

About the same time as above incident a crowd of coolies intimidated a garbage coolie on Sinza Road near Chengtu Road, breaking one of the wheels of his garbage cart. Four of these men, cleansing coolies attached to the Markham Road Depot, were arrested and charged with intimidation. (F.I.R. 2769/40 Sinza).

At 10-30 a.m. on 30/9/40 Inspector Philipoff, Soochow Road P.W.D. Depot, reported to this station by telephone that six male Chinese riding on bicycles were attempting to intimidate cleansing coolies working in this district. Duties were warned to keep observation for these men, but no arrests were made.

page_data.en:
At 8.15a.m. on 30-9-40, while complainant, a
P.W.D. garbage coolie, was pulling garbage cart No.
156 along Sinsa Road near Chengtu Road, a crowd of
about fifty male Chinese surrounded him and
intimidated him to cease work. They removed the
wheels from the vehicle, breaking one of same with
various implements which they carried. This was
observed by C.P.C. 3328, who telephoned the Station,
and S.I. Chen Tsing Tsang proceeded to the scene.
The intimidators dispersed, but with the assistance
of C.P.C. 3328, S.I. Chen succeeded in arresting
the four accused who were among them. At the time
of their arrest the accused had in their possession
one spade, one broom, one spade handle, and one
broom handle.

The four accused are all P.W.D. cleansing coolies
attached to the Markham Road Depot, and had no
reason to be east of Carter Road. When questioned
by C.D.S. 332 and the undersigned, they denied
having been concerned in the intimidation of
complainant. They alleged that they had themselves
been intimidated on Markham Road near Gordon Road
by a large number of unknown male Chinese, who
forced them to accompany them to Sinsa Road where
complainant was intimidated.

Owing to the large number of persons involved
complainant is unable to identify the four accused
as having taken part in the intimidation, but there
is no doubt that they are involved in same.

Mr. Harbottle, P.W.D., was informed and he
requested that the accused be charged.
page_data.zh:
1940年9月30日上午8时15分，原告（一名工务局垃圾苦力）在成都路附近的新闸路上拉着第156号垃圾车时，约有五十名中国男子包围了他，并恐吓他停止工作。他们卸下车轮，并用随身携带的各种工具弄坏了其中一个车轮。此事被警号3328的华捕巡长观察到，他致电捕房，警司陈清藏（Chen Tsing Tsang）随即赶赴现场。恐吓者四散，但在警号3328华捕巡长的协助下，陈警司成功逮捕了其中的四名被告。逮捕时，被告身上持有一把铁锹、一把扫帚、一根铁锹柄和一根扫帚柄。

四名被告均为隶属于麦高恩路车队的工务局清洁苦力，没有理由出现在卡特路以东。当接受警号332的华捕侦探及本人讯问时，他们否认参与恐吓原告。他们声称自己在戈登路附近的麦高恩路上受到大量不明中国男子的恐吓，被迫随同前往新闸路，在那里原告受到了恐吓。

由于涉及人数众多，原告无法指认这四名被告参与了恐吓，但毫无疑问他们卷入其中。

已通知工务局的 Harbottle 先生，他要求对被告提出指控。

Sept. 29th, 40

Interference with P.W.D. employees.

D.S. Baldock Inspector,
Officer i/c

Sir,

At 6.20 a.m. on the 29-9-40 a telephone message was received from Mr. M.K. Yabuoke, P.W.D. overseer, attached to the North Honan Road Depot, reporting that some of his coolies had been interfered with.

Enquiries were carried out by C.D.C. 82 and D.S. 103 Baldock, which revealed the following facts:-

At about 5.55 a.m. 29-9-40 three garbage coolies each having one shovel and one garbage handcart, proceeded to North Soochow Road near Kansuh Road accompanied by a foreman named Poh Ah Kung (周阿公).

On arrival at the above mentioned place and having commenced to load their carts with garbage, about ten male Chinese (believed to be P.W.D. coolies on strike) approached them, and after telling the coolies that they should stop working in sympathy with the coolies already on strike, they overturned the garbage carts and threw the three shovels into the Soochow Creek, after which they made good their escape in a northern direction along Kansuh Road.

Another incident occurred on Tsepo Road near North Shanse Road at about 6.20 a.m. when six male Chinese who were also believed to be P.W.D. coolies on strike, approached two loyal coolies who were sweeping the road, and told them that if they carried on working they would be assaulted.

Information.

先生：

1940年9月29日上午6点20分，接到隶属于北河南路堆栈的工部局监工 M.K. Yabuoke 先生的电话报告，称他的一些苦力受到干扰。

经刑事侦缉处第82号警员及警探103号 Baldock 进行调查，查明以下事实：-

1940年9月29日上午5点55分左右，三名清道夫每人持一把铁锹和一辆垃圾手推车，在一名名叫 Poh Ah Kung（周阿公）的工头陪同下，前往靠近甘肃路的北苏州路。

到达上述地点并开始将垃圾装上手推车时，大约十名中国男子（据信是正在罢工的工部局苦力）走近他们，在告诉这些苦力应该出于同情已罢工苦力而停止工作后，他们掀翻了垃圾车，并将三把铁锹扔进苏州河，随后沿甘肃路向北方向逃之夭夭。

另一事件发生在上午6点20分左右的山西北路附近的芝罘路，当时六名中国男子（也被认为是正在罢工的工部局苦力）走近两名正在扫路的忠诚苦力，并告诉他们如果继续工作就会遭到殴打。

TRANSLATION
To Officers of S.M.C.
Dear Sirs,
We have the honour to remind you that we went on
strike owing to our small pay previously, but it was all
settled. We should be satisfied and do our best to avoid
a repetition of such occurrence. However, due to the rapid
increase of cost of living - especially in rice & fuel - we
could hardly meet our personal expenses with our present pay.
How are we going to support our family? You are making a
few hundred dollars a month, which is about ten times as much
as our pay. How much can you save after paying all your
bills? We are afraid there will be very little left if there
is any. Please have sympathy on us and speak to the Head
officer favourably for us. We sincerely hope that you will
not treat this petition as means of intimidation. What we
now request is $30.00 rice allowance or an equivalent increase
in pay. The workers of the Tramway & Bus Companies who were
getting 3 to 4 dollars a day went on strike because they could
not carry on their living with their pay. Just imagine how
could we get on with ours.
Should our petition meet with your favourably
consideration, not only us but also all members of our family
will be highly appreciated.

From
All workers.

/Tsao.
page_data.zh:
译文
致工部局各位官员
尊敬的先生们，
我们荣幸地提醒各位，此前我们因工资微薄而罢工，但问题已全部解决。我们本应感到满意并尽力避免此类事件再次发生。然而，由于生活成本迅速上涨——尤其是大米和燃料——我们目前的工资几乎难以维持个人开销。我们要如何养家糊口？你们每月赚取数百美元，大约是我们工资的十倍。在支付所有账单后，你们能剩下多少？我们担心即使有剩余也寥寥无几。请对我们表示同情，并向主管官员为我们美言几句。我们真诚希望各位不要将这份请愿书视为恐吓手段。我们现在要求的是30.00美元的米贴或同等幅度的加薪。电车公司和巴士公司的工人每天收入3到4美元，也因无法依靠工资维持生活而罢工。试想一下，我们又该如何维持生计。
如果我们的请愿能得到各位的有利考虑，不仅是我们，我们所有的家庭成员都将感激不尽。

来自
全体工人。

/Tsao.

Strike at Shunteh Road P.W.D. Depot.

At 6.30 a.m. on the 27/9/40, S.I. Hsing (despatched
by Officer i/c Sinza to visit Shunteh Road) telephoned
that there was labour unrest at the Shunteh Road P.W.D.
Depot and that coolies of the Highway and Transport
Sections, attached to that depot, had failed to report for
work.

A party of Police under S.I. Glanville and D.S.I.
Sorrie attended and whilst they were inside the Depot
making enquiries, several ordure carts were overturned
by strike agitators on Markham near Shunteh Road.

Circulated.

Further enquiries by the undersigned and D.S.I. Li
Shih Chung ascertained from Mr. J.B. Flashman, P.W.D.
that at 6 a.m. even date, approx. 421 regular members
of the Highway & Transport Sections had reported for
work and had been detailed and despatched on their various
duties along with approx. 500 casual coolies.

These had been contacted on their various jobs and
by prevailed upon by cajolery and intimidation to cease
work, and by 8.20 a.m. even date, all the above employees
were on strike.

No demands had been presented by the strikers and
no meetings held in the Sinza District.

All P.W.D. Depots in this district have been placed
under Police guard pending future developments.
D.O. "B" and D.D.O. "B" informed.

顺泰路工部局堆栈罢工。

1940年9月27日上午6点30分，辛督察（由新闸负责警官派往顺泰路）打电话称，顺泰路工部局堆栈出现劳工动荡，隶属于该堆栈的道路和运输部门的苦力未能报到上班。

由 Glanville 高级督察和 Sorrie 警探长率领的一队警察到场，当他们在堆栈内进行调查时，几名罢工煽动者在靠近顺泰路的马克姆路上掀翻了几辆粪车。

已传阅。

经本人及李士忠警探长进一步调查，从工部局 J.B. Flashman 先生处获悉，当天上午6点，约421名道路和运输部门的正式成员已报到上班，并与约500名临时苦力一起被分配并派往各自岗位执行任务。

这些人在各自的工作岗位上被接触，并通过哄骗和恐吓被迫停止工作，截至当天上午8点20分，上述所有员工均处于罢工状态。

罢工者未提出任何要求，新闸区内也未举行任何集会。

该区所有工部局堆栈均已置于警察 guard 之下，以待事态发展。

At 7.20 a.m. 27.9.40. C.P.C. 1175 came to the
station and reported that a number of P.W.D. ordure
coolies were picketed from functioning their routine
work and that several ordure carts had been overturned
on Gordon Road near Penang Road.

agitators responsible for the incident had already
dispersed. Five ordure carts had been overturned on
roadway and the ordure coolies missing.

C.D.S. 132 and C.D.C. 145 ascertained that at 6 a.m.
27.9.40. when all the ordure coolies left the Ordure
Cleaning Service Depot, West Soochow Road near Penang
Road for the routine morning service, a number of P.W.D.
highway coolies approached, obstructed them and threaten-

majority of the coolies complied with the request, while
others, who had already left the depot before the
picketing, were stopped while on their way to the
Penang Road Ordure Jetty, by a number of agitators who
attacked them and overturned several carts. The
ordure coolies ran away to avoid a beating.

On the morning of September 30, some 300
transport coolies attached to Shunteh Road Depot reported
for duty, but did not start work because of intimidation.
The 600 road construction coolies attached
to Shunteh Road Depot, attended roll call and were
detailed for work but failed to commence work.
Some 680 garbage coolies attached to Markham
Road Depot turned up this morning, but did not begin
work after roll call.
The road construction coolies and garbage
coolies totalling some 700 attached to Soochow Road
Depot are working as usual.
Dissension exists among the coolies of the
Public works Department. A number of them accused the
Transport workers of being responsible for the current
agitation, and voiced dissatisfaction with the latter for
having betrayed their colleagues by resuming work.
Isolated cases of intimidation took place this
morning, At about 4 a.m., several ordure carts and
a quantity of tools used by road consturction and
garbage coolies were thrown into the Soochow Creek at
Markham Road Jetty.
Mr. Tlatlow, a foreign employee attached to
Markham Road Depot, while proceeding on a bicycle, met
a party of coolies on Gordon Road near Haiphong Road.
The coolies attempted to hold up the foreigner and assault
him, but he succeeded in taking refuge in the U.S, Marines

Some 900 coolies, including 600 road

attached to the Shunteh Road Depot of the Public

start work and left the depot at 6.30 a.m. 300
road construction coolies and 50 transport workers
resumed work later.

Workers totalling some 120 attached to the
Buildings Department, 753 Gordon Road, reported for
duty at 7 a.m., but they left at 8 a.m. for fear of
possible intimidation.

Road Depot turned up this morning and carry on
their work. As a result of intimidation by agitators,
about fifty of them were unable to continue their work,
following their broomsticks and dust bins having been
broken.

Cases of intimidation took place this morning,
when several garbage carts and ordure carts were
upset at the following places :-

Markham Road jetty;
West Soochow Road near Tatung Road;
Honan Road near Ningpo Road.

About 1,500 road construction coolies of the
Public Works Department declared a strike to-day,
September 27, with a view to agitating for an increase
in wages. The trouble commenced at about 6 a.m., when
some 900 road construction coolies attached to Shunten
Road Dep〔t refused to start work. They were told that
the P.W.D. authorities would grant them a wage increase
of three cents a day, but were apparently disatisfied
with this offer. Some 600 road construction coolies
attached to Soochow Road Depot later joined in the
strike.

Intimidation was carried out by the road
construction coolies after the declaration of the strike.
During the morning of September 27, a number of
scavengers were prevented from working in various parts
of the Western District. Broomsticks and dust bins
were broken and garbage carts were upset. Cases of
intimidation also took place on the same morning against
the ordure coolies when several ordure carts were upset
at Markham Road jetty and Penang Road near West Soochow
Road. The strikers further intimidated the workers
attached to the Buildings Department, 753 Gordon Road,
with the result that about 120 workers ceased operations.

According to information previously obtained,
the General Labour Union, Lane 95, 10 Edinburgh Road,
O.O.L., is believed to be concerned in the agitation.

D. C. (Special Branch)
Loh Wei Kong
D. S. I.

公共工程局的约1,500名筑路苦力于今日，
9月27日宣布罢工，旨在鼓动增加工资。麻烦始于上午6点左右，当时
隶属于顺泰路仓库〔t（原文残缺）的约900名筑路苦力拒绝开始工作。他们被告知
公共工程局（P.W.D.）当局将给予他们每天三分钱的加薪，但他们显然
对此提议不满意。后来，隶属于苏州路仓库的约600名筑路苦力也加入了
罢工。

宣布罢工后，筑路苦力实施了恐吓。
在9月27日上午，西区各处的许多清道夫
被阻止工作。扫帚和垃圾桶被毁坏，垃圾车被掀翻。同日上午还发生了针对
粪夫的恐吓事件，当时几辆粪车在马克姆路码头和靠近西苏州路的
槟榔路被掀翻。罢工者还恐吓了隶属于
戈登路753号工务局的工人，导致约120名工人停止作业。

根据此前获得的信息，位于爱丁堡路10号95弄的
总工会（General Labour Union，音译），O.O.L.（原文缩写），被认为参与了此次骚动。

The 100 carpenters and coolies attached to the Gordon Road Depot of the Architectural Branch of the Public Works Department, 753 Gordon Road, who raised objections to the dismissal of a foreman, resumed work at 2 p.m., September 3.

At about 9.30 a.m., the workers called at the head office of the Public Works Department in an endeavour to appeal against the dismissal of the foreman in question. On their arrival, the following representatives were appointed by the workers :

Loh Ping Sung (陸炳生)
Tsai An Chiao (蔡阿巧)
Sung Ching Keu (沈金根)
Zung Ah Ying (陳阿英)

During an interview, Mr. F.W. Cook, Assistant Building Surveyor of the Public Works Department informed the labour delegates that the workers were not in a position to interfere with the dismissal of the foreman, and that the authorities would make investigations into the trouble between the foreman and Mr. Archipoff. They were also told that no workers would be assaulted by foreigners in future, and further promised normal pay provided that they resumed work in the afternoon. The workers departed at 11.50 a.m. and reported for duty at 2 p.m.

P.W.D. - STRIKE PRECAUTIONS

In the event of a strike of P.W.D. coolies it will be necessary
for the Police to ensure that essential services are carried on with
the minimum possible interference.

The P.W.D. requirements are as follows:-

General

(1) Protection of P.W.D. Depots and staff engaged on essential services.
It is estimated that 6 gangs would be engaged on transport and
emergency work.

(2) Protection of tools and equipment on works in progress, until they
can be removed to a place of safety.
Locations will be notified when necessary, through C.C.R.

(3) Protection of barriers on works in progress on public roads by day,
and danger lamps by night.
Location of same will be notified, and wherever possible excavations
will be filled in to reduce the number of danger points.
The officer i/c C.C.R. will arrange to warn the public by radio to
watch for dangerous openings in the roads which may not be protected.

(4) To prevent any interference with manholes or sewers.
Duties to be warned to arrest anyone found tampering with manhole
covers.

(5) Protection of staff engaged on emergency work by Divisions as
follows:-

"A" Division

(a) Protect Soochow Road Depot, Workshops and Cart Parks, Amoy Road.

(b) Flood Prevention work, mainly on the Bund and near Nanking-Chekiang
Roads corner.

6 gangs of 6 men and 1 foreman each, employed sweeping main roads.
2 C.P.C.s to each gang.

6 gangs of 6 men and 1 foreman each, collecting accumulations on

工务局 - 罢工预防措施

如果发生工务局苦力罢工，警方有必要确保基本服务受到的干扰降至最低。

工务局的要求如下：-

一般情况

(1) 保护工务局仓库及从事基本服务的工作人员。
估计将有6个班组从事运输和紧急工作。

(2) 保护在建工程中的工具和设备，直到它们可以被转移到安全地点。
必要时将通过中央无线电台（C.C.R.）通知地点。

(3) 白天保护公共道路上在建工程的屏障，夜间保护危险警示灯。
将通知相同的位置，并在可能的情况下回填挖掘处以减少危险点的数量。
负责中央无线电台的警官将安排通过无线电警告公众注意道路上可能未受保护的危险开口。

(4) 防止任何人干扰井盖或下水道。
职责包括警告逮捕任何被发现篡改井盖的人。

(5) 按以下分区保护从事紧急工作的工作人员：-

“A”区

(a) 保护苏州路仓库、车间及厦门路的马车停车场。

SECRETARIAT S.M.C.

Allegations against Tseng and Chinese detectives.

A man named Tseng Chiu-fun (岑九陳) is a bad character among the members of the Citizens' Federation. His fact is known to the public and cannot be denied. Some time ago he incited road workers to go on strike, and he was prosecuted by the Council after investigation. The 18th August incident occurred while his case was in course of appeal; he was bailed out. As he has not completed his term of sentence, he should repent his misdeeds and be law-abiding; but instead of becoming a new man he is worse than ever. In league with Detectives Kao Yi-keng (根延高) and Wong Pei-yuan (元培汪) he extorts money from people, relying on the influence of these two associates.

Some time ago he founded a Rent Reduction Association and built the Hsing Nieh Building (樓大業興) to blackmail rich people. He has committed many offences and victimized countless number of persons. Because he has Kao and Wong behind him, his victims can only remain silent; they are afraid of his vicious influence so they dare not complain. Recently he had the audacity to instigate road workers to go on strike and demand higher wages. Ostensibly Kao and Wong were the representatives of the workers during arbitration, but actually Tseng was behind the scene. These three people had previously planned to rob the road workers of their hard-earned money so that they might divide it among themselves.

A few days ago he rented room No.476 in the Chiah Loh Hotel (店飯祿爵), Yu Ya Ching Road, under the false name of Loh (陸). Since then he has been secretly planning, day and night, with Kao and Wong to commit some act prejudicial to the peace and

对曾氏及华人侦探的指控。

一名叫岑九陈（Tseng Chiu-fun）的人在市民联合会成员中是个坏分子。此事公众皆知，不可否认。前一段时间，他煽动修路工人罢工，经调查后被公董局起诉。“八·一八”事件发生时，他的案件正在上诉中；他被保释。由于他尚未服满刑期，本应悔过自新、遵纪守法；但他非但没有改过自新，反而变本加厉。他与侦探高延根（Kao Yi-keng，原文如此，疑为高延根之误植或另一人）和汪培元（Wong Pei-yuan）勾结，倚仗这两名同伙的势力敲诈勒索百姓。

前一段时间，他成立了一个减租协会，并建造了兴业大楼（Hsing Nieh Building，音译）来勒索富人。他犯下许多罪行，受害者不计其数。因为背后有高、汪二人撑腰，受害者只能保持沉默；他们害怕他的恶劣影响，不敢投诉。最近，他竟厚颜无耻地煽动修路工人罢工并要求提高工资。表面上，高、汪二人在仲裁期间是工人的代表，但实际上曾某在幕后操纵。这三人事先策划抢劫修路工人的血汗钱，以便分赃。

几天前，他在虞洽卿路（Yu Ya Ching Road）爵禄饭店（Chiah Loh Hotel，音译）以陆（Loh）姓假名租用了476号房间。此后，他一直与高、汪二人日夜秘密策划，从事某些危害和平及

good order of the Settlement. As the matter is quite important
I cannot keep silent and have ventured to make this report. The
Secretary is begged to quietly and immediately arrest the said
Zen and to severely punish him as a warning to all lawless elements.
    Zeng resides on the upper floor of the T'ien Tung Primary
School (學小潼天), Ta Chih Li (里吉大), Tiendong Road.
Please do not let this report be known to Kao and Wong lest they
give information to Zeng and enable him to escape. In that case
it will be very difficult to apprehend him in future.
            (Signed) Yi Tseng-fong.

Subject. P.W.D. - alleged formation of labour union proved groundless

Made by. D.S.I. Hide Forwarded by. D.I. Crawford

On the afternoon of May 22nd, 1940, Mr.
D.E. Harbottle, Senior Assistant Engineer, Cleansing
and Transport, P.W.D., delivered to Special Branch
Headquarters a report submitted by Chief Inspector
H. Rose which reads as follows :-

Soochow Road Depot
Cleansing Station
May 22nd, 1940

Mr. Harbottle,

Re formation of P.W.D. Labour Union

It has come to my notice that a Union
is to be formed of all Highways, Cleansing, Transport
and other Sections of this Department. The first
Meeting will be held to-night after 5 p.m. in a
Tea Shop located at the corner of Amoy & Chekiang
Roads. Notices have been circulated to all coolies
calling them to attend and the the entrance fee
will be one dollar and twenty cents per month
afterwards. The Principal of the Union is one Tsui
Chu Foong (陳九峰) who originally worked in the
Eastern District as a Lawyers Assistant and is well
known as a bad character. I suggest that this case
be put in the hands of the Police, Special Branch
for investigation and if possible smashed at once.

Yours faithfully
(Signed) H. Rose, Chief Inspector.

（左侧手写批注：Copy out.）
（左下角印章：(S.B.) REC DATE 25/5/40）

1940年5月22日下午，工务局清洁与运输部高级助理工程师哈博特尔（D.E. Harbottle）先生向特别支部总部提交了一份由总督察H.罗斯（H. Rose）提交的报告，内容如下：-

苏州路仓库
清洁站
1940年5月22日

哈博特尔先生，

关于工务局工会的组建

我获悉，本部门的所有道路、清洁、运输及其他科室将组建一个工会。第一次会议将于今晚5点后在厦门路与浙江路拐角处的一家茶馆举行。通知已发给所有苦力，号召他们参加，之后的入会费为每月1.20元。工会的主要负责人是崔九峰（Tsui Chu Foong，音译，原文注陈九峰），他最初在东区担任律师助理，是个众所周知的坏分子。我建议将此案交由警方特别支部调查，并尽可能立即予以取缔。

此致
敬礼
（签名） H. 罗斯，总督察。

Enquiries were immediately instituted among
the leading P.W.D. coolies but no confirmation
of the above report could be gained. Between
4.45 p.m. and 7 p.m., a detective maintained
observation in the vicinity of the Dong Loh Tea
Shop at the corner of Chekiang and Amoy Roads
but nothing of interest was noted.

Chief Inspector Rose stated that the
information was passed to him by Hsu Shao Kong
(徐少公), Chief Foreman of Soochow Road Depot
who was referred to in Special Branch report of
May 20th as having informed the garbage coolies
that they would receive a 25% increase in pay with
effect from July 1st. Similar reports were also
received from foremen Li Vee Teh (李多德) and
Zung Hung Ping (陈洪林).

Zung Hung Ping stated he knew nothing except
what Hsu Shao Kong had told him and Hsu Shao Kong
said he had received his information from Li Vee Teh.

Lee Vee Teh admitted having told Hsu Shao
Kong that a meeting of coolies representatives
had been arranged for 5 p.m. on May 22nd and
stated he had received this information from three
foremen, namely, No. 27 Hsu Dzu Hai (徐祖海), No. 61
Sung Ah-nyi (宋阿二) and No. 63 Yang Kwang Tsing
(杨广庭). He denied having mentioned notices,

Cleansing Section.
May 2nd, 1940.

Mr. Harbottle,

Re: Formation of P.W.D. Labour Union.

It has come to my notice that a Union
is to be formed of all Highways, Cleansing, Transport
and other sections of this Department. The first
Meeting will be held to-night after 5 p.m. in a
Tea Shop located at the corner of Amoy & Chekiang
Roads. Notices have been circulated to all coolies
calling them to attend and that the entrance fee
will be one dollar and twenty cents per month
afterwards. The Principal of the Union is one Tsui
Chu Fong (陳九峰) who originally worked in the
Eastern District as a Lawyer's assistant and is well
known as a bad character. I suggest that this case
be put in the hands of the Police, Special Branch
for investigation and if possible smashed at once.

Yours faithfully,

Chief Inspector.

哈博特尔先生：

事由：工务局劳工工会之成立。

本人获悉，本局所属道路、清洁、运输及其他各科人员拟组建一工会。首次会议将于今日下午5时后在厦门路与浙江路转角处的一家茶室举行。已向所有苦力散发通知，召集其参会，并规定此后每人每月缴纳会费一元二角。该工会主要负责人为崔九峰（Tsui Chu Fong，音译），此人原在东区担任律师助理，素以品行不端著称。本人建议将此案移交警务处特务科调查，如可能则立即予以取缔。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Intimidation of P.W.D. Street cleaner.

At 6.15 a.m. 15-5-40 Mr. Szegedi P.W.D. Inspector telephone the station requesting assistance to have about 70 men of the road cleaning department who desired to start work escorted to their work as they were being intimidated by strikers. F. . Newell and party of police and detectives attended and ascertained 30 coolies ready to start work had been intimidated at North Honan and Haining Roads crossing by strikers and had had to return to the Depot at North Honan Road. (6 a.m.)

Police escorted them to sections in this district in parties of 4 and they will continue working alone when spread through the district it not being thought strikers will again interfere with them.

At about 4 p.m. on 16-5-40 Inspector Boorman
received telephone message from Inspector G.N. Philipoff
in charge of the T.D. Central District offices 933
Soochow Road, reporting that at about 5 p.m. same date
wages will be paid to 500 coolies and requesting to
detail more police at the Depot in the event of trouble.
Inspector Boorman personally attended and left
two extra C.P.Cs. at the Depot.
At 5.10 p.m. 16-5-40 a telephone message was
received at this station from T.D. Depot 933 Soochow
Road reporting fighting between strikers.
Inspector Boorman and party attended and 10 minutes
later(at 5.20 p.m.) another telephone message was
received from P.S. 49 Rosenoff on special duty at the
Depot requesting services of the Reserve Unit.
Officer in Charge Louze, Senior Detective i/c,
D.Ss. Turner, MacLennan the undersigned, C.D.I. 98 and
party attended arriving at the scene together with the
Reserve Unit West under Supt Chamberlain.
Enquiries ascertained the following:-
At about 4.30 p.m. on 16-5-40 a number of coolies
attended the offices at 933 Soochow Road to receive
their wages for the past 3 days, when the badges were
collected from them by Inspector Philipoff. The coolies
should produce their badges when receiving pay, badges
to be returned to them, on the following morning. This
according to Inspector Philipoff is a usual procedure

制作人。D. J. 菲利普夫（Philipoff）。转呈人。〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕

1940年5月16日下午4时许，布尔曼（Boorman）督察接到负责交通处中央区办公室（苏州路933号）的G.N. 菲利普夫（Philipoff）督察的电话消息，报告称同日约下午5时将向500名苦力发放工资，并请求在发生骚乱的情况下增派警力驻守堆栈。布尔曼督察亲自到场，并在堆栈留驻了两名额外的中国巡捕。

1940年5月16日下午5时10分，本巡捕房接到苏州路933号交通处堆栈的电话报告，称罢工者之间发生斗殴。布尔曼督察率队到场，10分钟后（下午5时20分），又接到在该堆栈执行特别任务的49号巡捕罗森诺夫（Rosenoff）的电话，请求后备队支援。

主管官员卢兹（Louze）、高级侦探主管、侦探沙恩（D.Ss.）特纳（Turner）、麦克伦南（MacLennan）、具名人、中国侦探督察（C.D.I.）98号及随行人员到场，与张伯伦（Chamberlain）警司率领的西区分区后备队一同抵达现场。

经查询查明以下情况：
1940年5月16日下午4时30分许，多名苦力前往苏州路933号办公室领取过去3天的工资，期间菲利普夫督察收走了他们的徽章。苦力在领薪时应出示徽章，徽章将于次晨发还。据菲利普夫督察称，此为常规程序

However, a number of these coolies coming out
from the Depot appealed to other coolies outside,
reporting that being deprived of their badges they
may be dismissed. An excitement resulted in a riot.
Bricks were thrown into the windows of the offices,
several glasses broken and S.M.D. motor car S.M.C.
Lic. No. 946 stationed in the compound badly damaged.
None of the S.M.D. office staff were injured, but
one of the coolies named Wong Kei Sun (王開孫) age
23 native of Kompo single residing in a straw hut off
Singapore Road C.O.L. received slight injury to his
head and was sent by Police to the Lester Chinese
Hospital, where the doctor's certificate was issued:-
"Laceration of scalp. Not serious".
At the time of arrival of the Reserve Unit the
situation calmed down, the coolies were given back
their badges at the request of Officer in charge Louza
and having been paid their wages left the offices in
good order. No arrests effected. At 6.10 p.m.
16-5-40 the Reserve Unit party were withdrawn from
the scene of the riot.
D.O. "A", D.D.O. "A" and D.C. (Divs) informed.

然而，部分从堆栈出来的苦力向外面的其他苦力呼吁，称因被没收徽章，他们可能会被解雇。由此引发激动情绪并导致骚乱。砖块被扔进办公室窗户，数块玻璃破碎，停在院内的工部局机动车（车牌号 946）严重受损。工部局办公室职员无人受伤，但一名名为王开孙（Wong Kei Sun）的苦力，23岁，广东籍，单身，居住在新加坡路附近的一处草棚内，头部受轻伤，由警方送往雷士德华人医院，医生出具证明如下：“头皮撕裂伤。不严重”。
